feedback_driven.quote: A simulator automatically generates timed test conversations, runs the system, and produces failure traces that identify the collaboration modules requiring repair.

persists_across_tasks.quote: A harness ablation further shows that this modular, verifiable loop outperforms the initial harness and repeated editing that lacks its diagnosis and repair archive.
